message.text: I am examining webhook.go to identify the exact request-signing mechanism.

Standard Webhooks uses HMAC-SHA256 with base64 headers: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, and webhook-signature (v1).

DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go; internal/webhook; Standard Webhooks (HMAC-SHA256)

q22.
DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go; internal/webhook; Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256

`CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, which loads the creator’s webhooks and posts via `webhook.PostAsync`. Delivery is `internal/webhook` (`Post` / `PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`). When a signing secret is set, the request is signed with HMAC-SHA256 per Standard Webhooks (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>`).
